$comment: Enumerated, hand-authored source mutations for paper/experiments/mutation/run.mjs. Each `find` MUST occur exactly once in `file` (run.mjs asserts this). `kind` is the classic mutation-operator family; `note` says what the mutant breaks.

mutants.note: mm() truncates instead of rounding
mutants.find: export const mm = (n: number): string => fmt2(Math.round(n));
mutants.replace: export const mm = (n: number): string => fmt2(Math.floor(n));

mutants.note: mm() drops the whole-millimetre rounding entirely
mutants.find: export const mm = (n: number): string => fmt2(Math.round(n));
mutants.replace: export const mm = (n: number): string => fmt2(n);

mutants.note: shortfall() can go negative
mutants.find: export const shortfall = (required: number, available: number): number => Math.max(0, required - available);
mutants.replace: export const shortfall = (required: number, available: number): number => required - available;

mutants.note: shortfall() subtracts the wrong way round
distPointToRect clamps x against the rect's HEIGHT
mutants.find: const nx = Math.min(Math.max(p.x, r.x), r.x + r.w);
mutants.replace: const nx = Math.min(Math.max(p.x, r.x), r.x + r.h);

mutants.note: distPointToRect clamps y against the rect's WIDTH
mutants.find: const ny = Math.min(Math.max(p.y, r.y), r.y + r.h);
mutants.replace: const ny = Math.min(Math.max(p.y, r.y), r.y + r.w);

mutants.note: distPointToRect returns Manhattan distance instead of Euclidean
approachGapMm: a blocker ending exactly ON the door line now takes the far branch
mutants.find: if (hi <= line) return Math.min(line - hi, depth);
mutants.replace: if (hi < line) return Math.min(line - hi, depth);

mutants.note: approachGapMm: the near-side gap is no longer capped at the required landing depth
mutants.find: if (hi <= line) return Math.min(line - hi, depth);

mutants.note: approachGapMm: near-side distance computed with the operands swapped
mutants.find: if (hi <= line) return Math.min(line - hi, depth);
mutants.replace: if (hi <= line) return Math.min(hi - line, depth);

mutants.note: approachGapMm: far-side distance computed with the operands swapped
mutants.find: if (lo >= line) return Math.min(lo - line, depth);
mutants.replace: if (lo >= line) return Math.min(line - lo, depth);

mutants.note: approachGapMm: a blocker straddling the opening reports FULL clearance
mutants.find:
if (lo >= line) return Math.min(lo - line, depth);
  return 0;
mutants.replace:
if (lo >= line) return Math.min(lo - line, depth);
  return depth;

mutants.note: frontGapMm: the uy tie-break now falls to the y branch instead of the x branch
frontGapMm: the +y facing gap is measured backwards
frontGapMm: the -y facing gap ignores the blocker's own depth
mutants.find: else if (uy < 0) gap = zone.y + zone.h - (blocker.y + blocker.h);
mutants.replace: else if (uy < 0) gap = zone.y + zone.h - blocker.y;

mutants.note: frontGapMm: the -x facing gap ignores the blocker's own width
frontGapMm no longer caps the gap at the required depth
frontGapMm can report a negative clearance (blocker overlapping the fixture)
frontGapMm reads the facing direction from corners, not centres
frontGapMm reads the vertical facing direction from corners, not centres
the 90 quarter-turn matrix turns counter-clockwise
the 180 matrix negates only x (a reflection, not a half-turn)
the 270 quarter-turn matrix turns the wrong way
makeFrame: `mirror x` becomes the identity and every other frame gets flipped
makeFrame: `mirror y` is read off the wrong axis token
makeFrame: column b scaled by the x mirror instead of the y mirror
composeFrame: the b entry multiplies the wrong parent row
mutants.find: const b = parent.a * child.b + parent.b * child.d;
mutants.replace: const b = parent.b * child.b + parent.a * child.d;

mutants.note: composeFrame drops the parent's own translation from tx
mutants.find: const tx = parent.a * child.tx + parent.b * child.ty + parent.tx;
mutants.replace: const tx = parent.a * child.tx + parent.b * child.ty;

mutants.note: composeFrame ignores the parent's linear part when carrying the child's origin
mutants.find: const ty = parent.c * child.tx + parent.d * child.ty + parent.ty;

mutants.note: composeFrame decides `reflected` from a positive determinant
composeFrame re-derives 90 and 270 the wrong way round
det() adds the anti-diagonal instead of subtracting it
isIdentity ignores the translation
tp() transposes the linear part when mapping y
mutants.find: return { x: f.a * p.x + f.b * p.y + f.tx, y: f.c * p.x + f.d * p.y + f.ty };
mutants.replace: return { x: f.a * p.x + f.b * p.y + f.tx, y: f.d * p.x + f.c * p.y + f.ty };

mutants.note: inverse() drops the adjugate's sign on b
inverse() does not negate the back-mapped translation
swapsAxes reads c instead of b (EXPECTED EQUIVALENT for signed permutations)
transformRect takes the max corner, so a turned rect shifts by its own extent
mutants.find: at: { x: Math.min(c1.x, c2.x), y: Math.min(c1.y, c2.y) },
mutants.replace: at: { x: Math.max(c1.x, c2.x), y: Math.max(c1.y, c2.y) },

mutants.note: transformRect never swaps w/h on a quarter-turn
mutants.find: size: swapsAxes(f) ? { w: size.h, h: size.w } : { w: size.w, h: size.h },

mutants.note: backVector points the 90 case the wrong way
degFromBack maps +x back to 270 instead of 90
transformDeg applies a transposed linear part to the back vector
mutants.find: return degFromBack({ x: f.a * v.x + f.b * v.y, y: f.c * v.x + f.d * v.y });
mutants.replace: return degFromBack({ x: f.a * v.x - f.b * v.y, y: f.c * v.x + f.d * v.y });

mutants.note: nsId namespaces the id backwards
transformArc keeps the rotational sense through a reflection
transformArc derives the start angle with atan2's arguments swapped
transformSegment leaves the host wall id un-namespaced
mutants.find: const out: WallSegment = { ...s, a: tp(f, s.a), b: tp(f, s.b), wallId: nsId(f, s.wallId) };
mutants.replace: const out: WallSegment = { ...s, a: tp(f, s.a), b: tp(f, s.b), wallId: s.wallId };

mutants.note: transformElement treats det == 0 as reflected too (EXPECTED EQUIVALENT: det is +/-1)
mutants.find:
const reflected = det(f) < 0;
  const id = nsId(f, el.id);
mutants.replace:
const reflected = det(f) <= 0;
  const id = nsId(f, el.id);

mutants.note: a door's swing no longer flips in a mirrored instance
a dim's offset no longer flips in a mirrored instance
a placed room keeps its relational constraint, so the plan pass re-places it
a placed fixture's owning-room reference is left un-namespaced
a column's cross-axis extents never swap on a quarter-turn
mutants.find: const size = swapsAxes(f) ? { w: el.size.h, h: el.size.w } : el.size;

mutants.note: a placed fixture's quarter-turn is not carried through the frame
a wall's opening positions are not carried through the frame
mutants.find: openings: el.openings.map((o) => ({ at: tp(f, o.at), width: o.width })),
mutants.replace: openings: el.openings.map((o) => ({ at: o.at, width: o.width })),

mutants.note: a polygon room's ring is left in local coordinates
a circular room's centre is left in local coordinates
mutants.find: if (el.circle) out.circle = { c: tp(f, el.circle.c), r: el.circle.r };
mutants.replace: if (el.circle) out.circle = { c: el.circle.c, r: el.circle.r };
